extracted.name: Sticky fig & port chutney
extracted.description: Get set for Christmas with this sticky make-ahead chutney. Serve as part of a cheeseboard alongside blue cheeses, or package to give as a gift
ingredient_lines: 1 rosemary sprig, leaves picked and chopped
instruction_lines: Put all of the ingredients in a pan. Simmer over a medium heat for 25-30 mins until sticky and jammy, adding 50ml water if it begins to stick. Leave to cool. Will keep in a sterilised jar for up to four months.
